long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Stamford, Connecticut, DiVosta moved to South Florida at twelve. He designed a first house at twenty and soon started a rock-lath contracting business. In Jupiter, he and his family built hundreds of homes before he partnered with Clifford Burg and adapted a French concrete-building system for fast, repeatable townhouse construction.

The business brought suppliers and trades in-house, limited buyer variations and compressed construction schedules. Demand for communities such as Garden Lakes and The Bluffs required sell-out events and lotteries. At Abacoa, DiVosta led residential development and remained president during the transition after Pulte acquired his company. Following the sale, he continued developing in Florida through Fort Pierce Building Company and other ventures.
long_biography.html:
Born in Stamford, Connecticut, DiVosta moved to South Florida at twelve. He designed a first house at twenty and soon started a rock-lath contracting business. In Jupiter, he and his family built hundreds of homes before he partnered with Clifford Burg and adapted a French concrete-building system for fast, repeatable townhouse construction.

The business brought suppliers and trades in-house, limited buyer variations and compressed construction schedules. Demand for communities such as Garden Lakes and The Bluffs required sell-out events and lotteries. At Abacoa, DiVosta led residential development and remained president during the transition after Pulte acquired his company. Following the sale, he continued developing in Florida through Fort Pierce Building Company and other ventures.
